title: Grimestone
body:
Grimestone is a green-colored stone That spawns exclusively in the Acidlands.

Description

Grimestone is one of the 2 nodes that spawn in the Acidlands. Grimestone can contain Ink, Greeb, and rarely Uranium.

Trivia

  • Grimestone's ore nodes are in the shape of mini spires, resulting in an elongated shape unlike other nodes.
  • In 1.71.0, a major update to Oaklands, the Acidlands was removed and replaced with the Snowlands. The location of Grimestone, Uranium, and Greeb were all been moved to Mike's Mines behind a destructible wall near the entrance of the Farland's (according to the Mike's Mine map) as a temporary home.
  • In 1.75.0 the Acidlands was brought back in the old location of the Snowands.
